name: CyTools_AudioStudio
description: Audio studio: multitrack editor, effects and VST3 workflows with tail rendering, sound-effect, music and voice generation (procedural, AudioLDM, ACE-Step 1.5, Piper, Qwen3-TTS, Fish Speech S2 Pro), voice presets, mastering tools. Standalone Dear ImGui application, CLI and MCP on one runtime.
author: Cyberalien
license: GPL-3.0-only (Tool code, see LICENSE). CyToolsCore SDK: MIT (LICENCES/CyToolsCore-MIT.txt). Engines and model weights keep their own licences: see backends, app/licenses.json and LICENCES/.

backends.name: Fish Speech S2 Pro (dialogue, cloning)
backends.license: Apache-2.0 (code); Fish Audio Research License (weights, non-commercial)

tested.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 24 GiB, driver 610.47; CPU paths for DSP, procedural SFX and Piper
tested.runtime: CPython 3.11.5 / CyToolsCore 0.9.0 / imgui-bundle 1.92.900 / pedalboard 0.9.25 / sounddevice 0.5.6; engine torch 2.8.0+cu128, transformers 4.57.3, diffusers 0.37.1, qwen-tts 0.1.1; engine piper-tts 1.8.0, onnxruntime 1.30.0
executed: Launcher CyTools_AudioStudio.exe from C:\ (smoke mode), every tab rendered EN and FR, log and advanced tabs, options round trip
Scripted editor session: import, gain, reverb with tail, undo, real playback through the default output, session save, workflow job applied to a selection

CLI: process_audio with tail, batch/convert/analyze, generate_sfx (procedural + AudioLDM), write_lyrics, generate_music (ACE-Step 20 s), voice_piper, voice_qwen3tts (1.7B, annotations), voice_fishspeech, generate_voice from a preset, prepare_tts_text (heuristic + Qwen3-1.7B), master_audio (loudness + Matchering)
MCP stdio: 36 tools discovered, invalid parameter refused, real jobs (list_effects, process_audio, generate_sfx, voice_piper)
VST3: CyDAW Test Gain (locally built JUCE plugin) scanned, described, rendered in a workflow, state captured
Model migration: 8 models + 1 Piper voice moved from the five former Tools and verified file by file

Track and master insert chains with 59 real-time effects and a VST3 plugin heard during playback through the renderer; effect interfaces rendered (compressor, EQ, multiband, reverb, delay, modulation, saturation, vocoder, analyser, stereo)
Automation lanes (volume, pan, insert parameters) edited by clicking and dragging on the timeline, rendered per frame/block, saved in sessions (schema 2)
Scripted interaction run 54 checks: FX button, Add insert, knob drag with undo, insert removal, master FX and gain, automation point add/move/undo, right-drag, hand tool, overview strip, ruler
CLI render_session on a saved session with inserts and automation (tail 1.3 s); MCP stdio 60 tools discovered

Second effect wave (22 more: real-time pitch and frequency shifters, rotary, ensemble, doubler, tape and tempo delays, formants, resonator, cassette, dynamic EQ, stereo imager, mid/side, look-ahead maximizer, multiband saturation, hum remover, de-clicker, dither, LUFS meter, test generator, channel tool): every one rendered block-wise, offline = live, unit-tested; dynamic EQ, loudness meter, rotary and maximizer interfaces rendered

Third effect wave (12 more: real-time spectral noise reduction, stutter, trance gate, reverse and dual delays, guitar amp and cabinets, pitch correction, harmoniser, shimmer and gated reverbs, vintage compressor styles): rendered block-wise, offline = live, unit-tested; noise reduction, pattern, pitch and amp interfaces rendered

Headless scripting: edit_session (new session from actions, render with tail; reopened, replace_audio, add and remove a track, render) and batch_session (3 sounds through a template session with a placeholder track: 3 mixes copied to an external folder); Linux not executed

Portable release build (CyTools_AudioStudio-0.1.0-win64.zip, 211 MB, private Python 3.11.9 from the NuGet package): unzipped outside the project, its own python runs tool.py describe (41 operations) and the unit tests (OK, 6 skipped), the launcher started from C:\ rendered the interface; cytools-app.zip passes the updater's extraction and verification
Effect... chain dialog (live audition, drag reorder, apply with tail), desktop file drops (GLFW callback + handler), searchable pickers: interaction run 68/68 at 1500 and 1035 px

operations.name: Process audio
operations.description: Render a workflow (effects, VST3 plugins, models) over a file, with tail rendering so reverb and delay decays are never cut. A selection processes only that region and overlaps its tail onto the following audio.

workflow.description: Inline workflow document (format cytools-audiostudio-workflow). Use workflow_name instead to reference a saved workflow.

workflow_name.description: Name of a workflow saved in data/workflows (see list_workflows). Empty = no processing.

subtype.description: Sample format for WAV/FLAC/AIFF (ignored by lossy formats)

selection_start.description: Start of the region to process (s); -1 = whole file

selection_end.description: End of the region to process (s); -1 = end of file

enabled.description: Keep rendering after the input ends until the output is silent (reverb/delay tails)

hold_seconds.description: Kept after the last audible sample (s)

tail.description: Tail rendering override; when omitted the workflow settings apply.

output_name.description: Output file name without extension; default = input name + suffix

operations.name: Batch process
operations.description: Render the same workflow over several files. Each output keeps the source name plus a suffix.

workflow.description: Inline workflow document (format cytools-audiostudio-workflow). Use workflow_name instead to reference a saved workflow.

workflow_name.description: Name of a workflow saved in data/workflows (see list_workflows). Empty = no processing.

subtype.description: Sample format for WAV/FLAC/AIFF (ignored by lossy formats)

suffix.description: Suffix appended to each output name

enabled.description: Keep rendering after the input ends until the output is silent (reverb/delay tails)

hold_seconds.description: Kept after the last audible sample (s)

tail.description: Tail rendering override; when omitted the workflow settings apply.

continue_on_error.description: Keep going when one file fails

operations.name: Convert audio
operations.description: Change format, sample rate, bit depth or channel count.

subtype.description: Sample format for WAV/FLAC/AIFF (ignored by lossy formats)

samplerate.description: Target sample rate; 0 keeps the source rate

channels.description: Target channels; 0 keeps the source layout

operations.name: Analyze audio
operations.description: Duration, peak, RMS, integrated loudness (LUFS), true peak, clipping, DC offset, leading/trailing silence.

operations.name: Render session
operations.description: Mix an editor session (tracks, insert chains, automation lanes, master bus) to a file; stateful inserts ring out after the end (tail).

session.description: Session folder or session.json saved by the editor

subtype.description: Sample format for WAV/FLAC/AIFF (ignored by lossy formats)

enabled.description: Keep rendering after the input ends until the output is silent (reverb/delay tails)

hold_seconds.description: Kept after the last audible sample (s)

tail.description: Tail rendering override; when omitted the workflow settings apply.

selection.description: Optional [start, end] seconds to render instead of the whole session

operations.name: Edit session (scripted)
operations.description: Create or open a session, apply actions (add / replace / remove tracks, add / move / reverse / remove clips, insert chains, master, tail, automation), save it and optionally render the mix. The headless counterpart of the editor.

session.description: Existing session folder or session.json; empty = new session

samplerate.description: Sample rate of a new session

clip.description: Clip id, exact name or index such as "0" (move_clip, remove_clip, reverse_clip)

to_track.description: Track that receives the clip (move_clip); its inserts then apply to it

after_clips.description: add_clip: a position already taken by a clip puts the new clip after the last one

inserts_from.description: Copy the chain and lanes of this track

workflow_name.description: Saved workflow to install as the chain

save_as.description: Session name (under data/sessions) or absolute folder; empty = do not save

render.description: Render the mix after the actions

subtype.description: Sample format for WAV/FLAC/AIFF (ignored by lossy formats)

enabled.description: Keep rendering after the input ends until the output is silent (reverb/delay tails)

hold_seconds.description: Kept after the last audible sample (s)

tail.description: Tail rendering override; when omitted the workflow settings apply.

operations.name: Batch sounds through a session
operations.description: Render a session once per input sound: each sound is placed in a slot track (an existing placeholder track whose audio is replaced, keeping its inserts and automation, or a new track), the mix is rendered with the tail, then the next sound takes its place.

track.description: Placeholder track name/id to replace, or name of the track to create

inserts_from.description: Copy the chain of this track onto a new slot track

workflow_name.description: Saved workflow to install on a new slot track

solo.description: Render the slot track alone (other tracks muted)

suffix.description: Suffix appended to each output name

subtype.description: Sample format for WAV/FLAC/AIFF (ignored by lossy formats)

enabled.description: Keep rendering after the input ends until the output is silent (reverb/delay tails)

hold_seconds.description: Kept after the last audible sample (s)

tail.description: Tail rendering override; when omitted the workflow settings apply.

operations.name: List effects
operations.description: Native effects available as workflow nodes and track inserts, with their parameter schemas; "realtime" marks the ones usable as inserts, "sidechain" the ones keyed by another track.

operations.name: List workflows
operations.description: Saved workflows in data/workflows.

operations.name: Get workflow
operations.description: Read a saved workflow document.

operations.name: Save workflow
operations.description: Persist a workflow document under data/workflows (explicit user action).

workflow.description: Inline workflow document (format cytools-audiostudio-workflow). Use workflow_name instead to reference a saved workflow.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing workflow of that name

operations.name: Scan VST3 plugins
operations.description: Scan folders for VST3 plugins in an isolated worker process and cache their parameters. A crashing plugin is reported, not fatal.

directories.description: Extra folders; the standard VST3 folders are always scanned

operations.name: List VST3 plugins
operations.description: Cached VST3 catalogue (run scan_plugins first).

operations.name: Describe VST3 plugin
operations.description: Load one VST3 plugin in a worker and return its parameters.

operations.name: Generate sound effect
operations.description: Text to sound effect. Backend sfx_procedural synthesises deterministically from a catalogue of 36 archetypes (no model, instant); backend audioldm runs the AudioLDM diffusion model on CPU or CUDA.

prompt.description: Description of the sound (English or French)

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds; null = natural length (procedural) or 5 s (audioldm)

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

operations.name: Preview procedural recipe
operations.description: Parse a prompt with the procedural synthesizer and return the exact recipe without rendering.

operations.name: List procedural sound types
operations.description: Archetypes of the procedural synthesizer with the English and French words that select them.

operations.name: Generate music
operations.description: Text to music with ACE-Step 1.5: a full arrangement, optional sung lyrics, optional style reference recording. 48 kHz stereo.

lyrics.description: Lyrics with optional [Verse]/[Chorus] tags; empty for instrumental

language.description: Vocal language (unknown = let the model decide)

keyscale.description: Key, e.g. "C Major"; empty = model decides

seed.description: Seed; null = random. Track N uses seed+N-1

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

plan_with_lm.description: Let the 5Hz planning language model refine caption, lyrics and metadata (+6 GiB VRAM)

reference_audio.description: Optional reference recording whose timbre and production are followed

reference_strength.description: How strongly the reference is followed

operations.name: Remix music
operations.description: Audio to audio: regenerate a recording under a new caption and optional lyrics while keeping its structure (task cover).

lyrics.description: Lyrics with optional [Verse]/[Chorus] tags; empty for instrumental

language.description: Vocal language (unknown = let the model decide)

keyscale.description: Key, e.g. "C Major"; empty = model decides

seed.description: Seed; null = random. Track N uses seed+N-1

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

operations.name: Repaint section
operations.description: Rewrite one time range of a recording and splice it back, leaving the rest untouched.

lyrics.description: Lyrics with optional [Verse]/[Chorus] tags; empty for instrumental

language.description: Vocal language (unknown = let the model decide)

keyscale.description: Key, e.g. "C Major"; empty = model decides

seed.description: Seed; null = random. Track N uses seed+N-1

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

end_seconds.description: End of the region; -1 = end of file

operations.name: Write lyrics
operations.description: Planning language model only: turn an idea into caption, lyrics and metadata (create) or format existing lyrics (format).

operations.name: Speak with Piper
operations.description: CPU text-to-speech with a Piper ONNX voice (22.05 kHz mono). Raw text only, no annotations.

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

processedFile.description: Result after the post workflow, when one was applied

preset.description: Reusable preset (parameters without text) to regenerate the same voice

operations.name: Speak with Qwen3-TTS
operations.description: Expressive text-to-speech: preset speakers with natural-language instructions (custom), voice cloning from a reference recording (clone) or voice design from a description (design). Inline [tone: ...] and [pause: 500ms] annotations are supported with the 1.7B CustomVoice model. 24 kHz mono.

text.description: Text to speak; paragraphs separated by blank lines

model.description: Model variant (custom needs CustomVoice, clone needs Base, design needs VoiceDesign)

x_vector_only.description: Clone from the speaker embedding only, no transcription

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

processedFile.description: Result after the post workflow, when one was applied

preset.description: Reusable preset (parameters without text) to regenerate the same voice

operations.name: Speak with Fish Speech S2 Pro
operations.description: Multi-speaker dialogue with natural-language expressions per turn and voice cloning from short references (0.1-30 s with their transcription). CUDA only, 44.1 kHz mono.

expression.description: Expression in natural language, e.g. whisper, excited

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

processedFile.description: Result after the post workflow, when one was applied

preset.description: Reusable preset (parameters without text) to regenerate the same voice

operations.name: Speak with a saved voice preset
operations.description: Regenerate a voice from a saved preset (backend, model, every parameter) with new text. Warns when a reference recording changed.

post_workflow.description: Override the preset post workflow (empty string = none)

processedFile.description: Result after the post workflow, when one was applied

preset.description: Reusable preset (parameters without text) to regenerate the same voice

operations.name: List voices
operations.description: Voices per backend: Piper voice catalogue (installed and downloadable), Qwen3-TTS speakers and modes, Fish Speech capabilities, and saved presets.

operations.name: Save voice preset
operations.description: Store the parameters of a voice (without text) as a reusable preset.

parameters.description: Parameters of the corresponding voice_* operation (text is ignored)

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

operations.name: List voice presets
operations.description: Saved voice presets.

operations.name: Delete voice preset
operations.description: Remove a saved voice preset.

operations.name: Prepare text for a voice
operations.description: Turn plain text into the markup a voice backend expects: [tone]/[pause] annotations for Qwen3-TTS, dialogue turns with expressions for Fish Speech, sentence-per-line text for Piper. Method heuristic needs no model; method llm uses the local Qwen3-1.7B assistant and falls back to the heuristic when its output is not usable. An AI client can skip this and annotate itself.

style.description: Overall delivery wanted (e.g. warm and calm narration)

fallbackReason.description: Why the llm output was replaced by the heuristic

operations.name: Transcribe audio
operations.description: Speech to text with Whisper large-v3 turbo (99 languages, segment timestamps). Used to get the exact transcription of a reference recording before cloning a voice.

language.description: Language code (fr, en, ...); empty = automatic detection

operations.name: Master audio
operations.description: Mastering: match a reference recording (Matchering: spectrum, dynamics and loudness) or normalise to a loudness target with a true-peak limiter. Optional post workflow.

subtype.description: Sample format for WAV/FLAC/AIFF (ignored by lossy formats)

post_workflow.description: Optional workflow (saved name) applied to the generated audio, with tail rendering.

operations.name: List models
operations.description: Catalogue and installation state of every model (state, size, present bytes, licence, source).

operations.name: Install model
operations.description: Download or resume a model with verification. The licence must be accepted personally when the source requires it; a gated source returns AccessRequired with the official page.

accept_license.description: I have read and accept the licence of this model

repair.description: Re-hash existing files and re-download corrupted ones

operations.name: Verify model
operations.description: Re-check presence, sizes and hashes of an installed model.

operations.name: Remove model
operations.description: Delete the files of a model under data/models.

operations.name: Engine status
operations.description: State of the engine environments (torch, piper), their sources and the worker pool.

operations.name: Install engine
operations.description: Create or repair an engine environment (PyTorch CUDA or CPU, Piper) at its final path, with vendored sources and an import check.

cpu_only.description: Install the CPU build of PyTorch

operations.name: Diagnose backend
operations.description: Start the worker of a backend and report engine versions, CUDA availability and resident models.

operations.name: Release workers
operations.description: Stop resident workers to free VRAM and RAM.
